data.one_liner: Download images and files from URLs to the local device file manager.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to download files and images from a provided URL directly to the file manager using Flutter. It handles the downloading process via HTTP and saves files through native file dialogs.
use_when: You need to save images or files from a URL to the user's device storage.
You want a simple function call to trigger file downloads.
avoid_when: You need advanced download queue management, background downloads, or pause/resume support.
You require complex file system organization beyond the basic file manager dialog.
strengths: Handles URL-based file saving out of the box.
weaknesses: Documentation contains incorrect permission recommendations in the README (mentions RECORD_AUDIO instead of file/storage permissions).
data.setup_notes: Change minimum Android SDK version to 21 or higher in build.gradle, and add internet permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.
